title: Repunit Coordinates for the Erdős Ternary-Digit Problem
summary: Paul Erdős conjectured that the only powers of two whose ternary expansions contain no digit 2 are 1, 4, and 256. Despite extensive computational verification, the conjecture remains open. We reformulate the problem using generalised base-4 repunits. Any admissible exponent is even, say \(n=2s\), and \[ 2^{2s}=4^s=3R_s(4)+1,\qquad R_s(4)=\frac{4^s-1}{3}. \] Thus \(2^{2s}\) omits the ternary digit 2 if and only if \(R_s(4)\) does.
